provenance.sourceDataset: scripts/sampling/candidates.json (prompts written for this toy, VIS-17)

truncation.note: the 256 most likely next tokens per prompt; the rest are summed into tailMass

parameters.values: logprobs are natural-log probabilities over the full 50,257-token vocabulary at temperature 1, rounded to 4 decimals

tailMassByTemperature.note: the tail's share of the probability when the full distribution is reshaped at each temperature

parameters.contextPrefixNote: every prompt is preceded by GPT-2's <|endoftext|> token, as each document was in training; it is not shown
parameters.forwardPassCheck: crosscheck.py against transformers 4.49.0 / torch 2.2.2 on the 107 round-1 prompts, 2026-10-01: same tokens, logits within 2.3e-4, log-probabilities within 7.5e-5, same top-256 sets

shapeRules.bimodal: two clear leaders: p2 >= 0.2, p2 >= 0.5 * p1, and p3 <= 0.5 * p2
shapeRules.flat: p1 <= 0.1 and the top 20 tokens together hold less than half the probability (n50 > 20)

parameters.runningSentence: How many r's are in strawberry?

runningSentence.sentence: How many r's are in strawberry?

curation.note: Shapes measured over every candidate run, by round. Later rounds add prompts aimed at a shape that was scarce; earlier ones are never edited. candidates.json has each prompt.
